message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in total number of employees, using headcount data from annual 10-K filings.", "rationale": "Rapid expansion in workforce may signal overinvestment or managerial over-optimism, while stable or declining employment could indicate operational discipline.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low or negative employee growth rate"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Turnover Surge", "construction": "The change in asset turnover ratio (sales divided by average total assets) from the previous year to the current year.", "rationale": "A sudden increase in asset turnover may capture temporary efficiency improvements or aggressive revenue recognition, potentially reversing.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low or negative recent changes in asset turnover"}, {"name": "Unrecognized Pension Obligation Ratio", "construction": "Unrecognized pension obligations scaled by total assets, extracted from pension footnotes in 10-K filings.", "rationale": "Large unrecognized pension liabilities create future cash flow drags that may not yet be priced.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low unrecognized pension obligation ratios"}, {"name": "Interim Inventory Swings", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly inventory levels over the trailing four quarters, divided by average inventory over that period.", "rationale": "Volatile inventory levels may indicate weak demand forecasting or channel stuffing risk.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low inventory volatility"}, {"name": "Option-Implied Volatility Slope", "construction": "Difference between implied volatilities of 3-month and 6-month at-the-money call options, using listed equity options data.", "rationale": "A steeply upward sloping term structure of implied volatility may indicate upcoming firm-specific risk that is not yet reflected in analyst coverage.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low or negative implied volatility slope"}, {"name": "Segment Revenue Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of revenue growth rates across reported business segments, taken from annual segment disclosures.", "rationale": "Firms with highly dispersed segment growth may face internal resource allocation issues or be more exposed to sector-specific shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low revenue dispersion across segments"}, {"name": "Excess R&D to SG&A", "construction": "Current year R&D expense divided by SG&A expense, minus median ratio for the firm's industry.", "rationale": "Excess R&D investment relative to peers may reflect overconfidence or indicate less near-term profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with below-industry-median R&D to SG&A ratios"}, {"name": "Cash Tax Gap", "construction": "Difference between effective cash tax rate (cash taxes paid divided by pretax income) and statutory federal tax rate.", "rationale": "A large negative gap can reveal aggressive tax avoidance or exposure to one-off tax benefits that may not persist.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with small or positive cash tax gaps"}, {"name": "Net Insider Transaction Ratio", "construction": "Net shares bought minus shares sold by insiders over the past 12 months, divided by shares outstanding, using SEC Form 4 filings.", "rationale": "High net insider selling can reflect adverse private information about future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high net insider buying ratios"}, {"name": "Late Filing Frequency", "construction": "Number of late quarterly or annual SEC filings in the past three years.", "rationale": "Frequent late filings may signal internal control weaknesses or hidden operational problems.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with zero or few late filings"}]}
